§aLoaded Chunks: ON
§6Loaded Chunk Mode (Restart Required)
§aAfter restarting with it off: no chunk-scan events, tick handler, processing queue, or chunk-state tracking are registered; runtime cost is effectively the same as not having this feature.
§eAfter restarting with it on: existing chunks are queued for one-time processing when they load, using the current replacement rules.
§ePerformance while enabled: medium to high during processing; at most 1 chunk is processed per tick to avoid burst scanning.
§cMore old loaded chunks and taller worlds take longer; completed chunks are marked and are not rescanned for the same rule type.
§aSave the current block merge rules. The Loaded Chunks switch only changes the next-launch state and takes effect after a full game restart.
§cChanging this switch requires a full game restart. Saving it only changes the next-launch state; it does not enable or disable the system live.
